subject: Billing scenario playback and next steps
body:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena@heliumhealth.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Billing scenario playback and next steps

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to iterate: 

Call summary (30m):
- Primary use case: clinical documentation summarization + triage across 3 hubs; inference calls are ~1.2k tokens on average with peak bursts during morning shift.
- Estimated starting volume: 20M tokens / month (baseline), growth to 120M tokens / month by Q4 if pilot scales.
- Constraint: procurement has a $90k–$140k annual budget target for inference (prefer committed pricing or pilot reservation).
- Success criteria for pilot: 30% latency improvement vs current infra and predictable per-token TCO at target $/1M tokens.

Attached artifacts I dropped into the Drive during the call: helium_billing_playbook_v1.xlsx (breakdown tabs: assumptions, conservative/baseline/peak scenarios), token-scenarios.csv (raw sample distribution), and a short pricing explainer PDF.

High-level billing scenarios (from the attached sheet):
- Conservative (Pilot small): 20M tokens/month -> estimate $540/month (equivalent $27.0 / 1M tokens) using on-demand hosted profile.
- Baseline (expected rollout): 60M tokens/month -> estimate $1,350/month (equivalent $22.5 / 1M tokens) with modest reserved-scheduling savings (5–10%).
- Peak (scale): 120M tokens/month -> estimate $2,100/month (equivalent $17.5 / 1M tokens) with reserved capacity + batching/kv-cache enabled.

These are workbook-derived, ballpark numbers that contain model selection (curated open model), batching assumptions, and small quantization uplift. The attached workbook enumerates toggles so you can see line-by-line where the unit economics change.

Questions / asks from our side for the formal estimate:
1) Can you confirm whether the 20M -> 120M trajectory is monthly tokens or total tokens across all environments (staging+prod)?
2) Do you have a preferred procurement route (PO + SOW vs. SaaS invoice)?
3) Any constraints on IP/retention we should include in the pilot SOW?

Next steps (proposed):
- You confirm trajectory + procurement route (Elena, Samir) — by end of week if possible.
- We send a tailored pilot invoice estimate and a 90-day reserved-capacity pilot option with clear step-up pricing.
- If accepted, we produce a one-page mutual action plan and kickoff technical onboarding.

Attachments referenced: [attachment: helium_billing_playbook_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)], [attachment: token-scenarios.csv (text/csv)], [attachment: redwood_pricing_breakdown.pdf (application/pdf)].

Thanks — I’ll hold off on a formal quote until I have confirmation on the trajectory and PO path.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.com

-----
From: Elena Garcia <elena@heliumhealth.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@heliumhealth.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Feb 2026 09:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Billing scenario playback and next steps

Thanks for the detailed recap, Tessa — this is super helpful. A few clarifications: 
- The 20M -> 120M is monthly tokens (we expect staging to add ~10% on top of prod).
- Procurement: we'll try PO + SOW but may start with a vendor invoice for the pilot to move faster.
- IP/retention: PHI is in scope for a subset of docs; we need SOC2 + KMS integration details in the SOW.

Quick ask: can you show an example invoice line items (monthly snapshot) so procurement can see how the billing will show up? Also, can you indicate whether there is a unit price we can lock for a 90-day pilot?

If you can send a short invoice stub and pilot pricing by EOD Thursday that would be amazing.

Elena
Elena Garcia
Head of Product Operations | Helium Health

-----
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena@heliumhealth.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 08:14:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Billing scenario playback and next steps

Great — thank you, Elena. Attached is a one-page invoice stub and a short pricing breakdown that maps to the workbook tabs. Key points below: 

Invoice stub (attached PDF) — example for Baseline scenario (60M/month):
- Hosting / inference units: $1,350/month (line item: Redwood Hosted - model v1 - 60M tokens)
- Pilot discount applied: 15% off the hosted line for 90-day pilot (applies to baseline and conservative scenarios)
- Optional reserved capacity uplift (monthly commitment) would add a separate "dedicated" line if you want lower $/1M tokens long term.

Pilot pricing option:
- 90-day pilot: lock current baseline unit price at $18.75 / 1M tokens (after 15% pilot discount on baseline on-demand profile) for up to 100M tokens/month.
- If you exceed 100M tokens/month during pilot, overage billed at baseline on-demand $22.50 / 1M tokens.

I also included a short technical appendix for SOC2 evidence and KMS integrations (see PDF tab "SecurityNotes"). Marcus — can you confirm the KMS integration steps and whether we need a separate SOW line for key management?

Action items: 
- Elena/Samir: confirm PO vs invoice route and whether PHI subset requires on-prem/private deployment (affects price).
- Elena: confirm whether 10% staging overhead should be included in our formal quote.
- Marcus/Laura (internal): need quick approval on the pilot discount and the proposed $18.75 / 1M lock for 90 days.

Attachments referenced: [attachment: redwood_pricing_breakdown.pdf (application/pdf)], [attachment: helium_billing_playbook_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)].

Thanks — I can produce a DocuSign-ready quote once we get confirmation on PO path; otherwise I’ll send a straight invoice estimate.

Best,
Tessa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Garcia <elena@heliumhealth.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 08:52:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Billing scenario playback and next steps

This looks good, Tessa — the $18.75 / 1M pilot lock is workable for procurement to evaluate. We will aim to start with an invoice for the pilot to avoid SOW delay; I’ll confirm PO path by Friday. Include the 10% staging overhead in the formal quote. Can you also add a short line showing expected monthly spend range for Conservative -> Peak for procurement's one-pager?

If you can get that to me this morning that would help.

Elena

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 09:34:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Billing scenario playback and next steps  — internal approval request

Internal summary and ask: 
- External confirmed: 10% staging overhead included, pilot will start on invoice path (procurement still may go PO later).
- We proposed 15% pilot discount (resulting $18.75 / 1M lock up to 100M tokens/month).
- Procurement asked for a Conservative -> Peak monthly spend line for their one-pager (I’ve added the three-scenario numbers into the attached workbook).

Please approve the 15% pilot discount and DocuSign-ready stub so I can route to Elena this morning. If approving via reply here helps timing, please respond with APPROVED or REJECTED and any redlines.

Thanks,
Tessa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
